title: Reuse: same symptoms on TRN-117
description: Another old unit, same symptoms; a colleague applies Erkki's trick and it works. Expected is a verification of the same topic on the same class (trust verified) so it merges with the existing rule; the honest alternative, [], would hide that the field confirmed the rule a second time.
subject: TRN-117 no traffic after SFP swap

incident.summary: No traffic on TRN-117 after an SFP swap

messages.text: Morning! I'm at Linnanmaa, just swapped the SFP on TRN-117. Link is UP and alarms cleared, but there is no traffic. Never seen this before, any ideas?
NOC here, confirming we see nothing coming through from your side. Coffee's on me if you fix it :)
Jaakko, check the traffic counters. UP, RX power normal and counters at zero?
RX power is normal. Counters sit at zero.
Yeah, that's a 2018 unit. Bounce the interface like Erkki's trick: disable, wait a bit, enable. Don't reboot the whole node and don't swap the SFP again.
Nice. Write it in your notes, it's not in the manual.

items.summary: On older transmission units, after an SFP swap, UP + normal optics + zero counters means a forwarding-state issue: bounce the interface before replacing hardware or rebooting.
items.diagnosis: forwarding-state issue, not a faulty SFP
items.action: Disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again.
avoid: reboot the unit (unless the interface bounce fails)
